US imposes 50% Section 338 tariffs on certain Canadian imports

Published July 20, 2026 | Updated Aug. 25, 2026

Effective August 22, the additional 50% Section 338 duties apply to covered Canadian dairy, alcoholic beverages and motor vehicles.

Chapter 99 headings 9903.03.12 through 9903.03.14 carry the 50 percent rate. Headings 9903.03.15 and 9903.03.16 list excluded categories at zero.

Coverage runs to 554 tariff subheadings across three proclamations.
